en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, origin unclear; Pehchevo is a town in eastern Macedonia. 'Двајс'/'тријсте' are shortened forms of twenty and three hundred; 'колџии' as night guards is my reading.

lines.cyr: не ти реков мари еднаш и два',
lines.lat: ne ti rekov mari ednaš i dva',
lines.en: did I not tell you, hey, once or twice,

lines.cyr: еднаш и двајс', мари, тријсте пати.
lines.lat: ednaš i dvajs', mari, trijste pati.
lines.en: once or twenty, hey, three hundred times.
Do not go out, Mago, at night time,
night time, Mago, in the alleys,
in the alleys, Mago, through Pehchevo.
The night guards will catch you, Mago,

lines.cyr: ќе фанат Маго, ќе те срамат.
lines.lat: ḱe fanat Mago, ḱe te sramat.
lines.en: they will catch you, Mago, they will shame you.

lines.cyr: Ќе ти врзат Маго бели раце,
lines.lat: Ḱe ti vrzat Mago beli race,
lines.en: They will tie your white hands, Mago,
your white hands, Mago, behind your back.
